description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 11.12.2023 to 17.12.2023
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and specifically deals with setting new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges. It falls under the Legal/Regulatory category as it constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for customs operations, amending previous regulations published in an earlier gazette.
